name: CI

# The PR gate: build, typecheck, test, lint, and the publish/provenance checks — everything `ready`
# plus the gates covers, split into parallel jobs. Runs on every PR and on pushes to main so a
# regression is caught before merge, not at docs-deploy or release-tag time.

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  # `workflow_dispatch` lets CodSpeed trigger a backtest run to seed baseline data for the
  # `benchmarks` job; jobs gated on `pull_request` simply no-op on a manual run.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Supersede in-flight PR runs; let main runs finish.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# Every job carries `timeout-minutes`. release.yml's gate waits on this workflow's conclusion with a
# 1-hour deadline, so a job left on the 6-hour default can hang the release even when it's advisory.
# Values are ~2.5x observed runtime — these catch hangs, not slow-but-working jobs.

env:
  # vp's task cache stores task OUTPUTS as .tar.zst tarballs, so a cache hit re-materializes the
  # gitignored generated dirs. The `build` job warms it; downstream jobs restore and replay
  # `vp run -r build` as a fast cache-extract instead of a cold rebuild.
  #
  # Key shape: `<prefix><os>-<hash(pnpm-lock.yaml, vite.config.ts)>-<run_id>-<run_attempt>`.
  #
  # The hash segment has to be in the SAVE key, not just the restore-keys — a restore-key only ever
  # matches a key some run actually wrote. Omitting it made `<prefix><os>-<hash>-` dead config that
  # could never match, silently degrading every restore to the broad `<prefix><os>-` fallback (i.e.
  # "the newest cache from any lockfile").
  #
  # The run_id/run_attempt tail keeps each attempt's key unique, because GH Actions cache keys are
  # immutable: a sha-based key can never be resaved by a rerun, so a `build` job whose auto-tracked
  # output snapshot was incomplete for that attempt would pin every downstream job (and every rerun of
  # the same commit) to that broken tarball forever. A fresh key per attempt means a rerun always
  # saves, and downstream jobs in this attempt exact-match this attempt's own build.
  VP_TASK_CACHE: node_modules/.vite/task-cache
  VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX: vp-taskcache-

jobs:
  automation-guard:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/guard-release-automation.yml
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore/save vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Build all packages
        run: vp run -r build
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  component-accessibility:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Materialize generated output
        run: vp run -r build
      - name: Re-audit components whose inputs changed
        run: vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:accessibility
      - name: Require committed evidence to match
        run: git diff --exit-code -- docs/public/accessibility/results.json
      - name: Summarize advisory results
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          found=false
          for summary in a11y-report/*/index.md; do
            if [ -f "$summary" ]; then

    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Materialize generated output
        run: vp run -r build
      - name: Generate docs theme curve
        run: node docs/scripts/site-themes.ts
      - name: Typecheck
        run: vp check

  foundation_changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      foundation: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.foundation }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Detect Foundation support changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@ceb8a2b8f2d89434be7ff52d3de7ec3738c5cc9d # v4.0.3
        with:
          filters: |
            foundation:
              - 'renderers/foundation/**'
              - 'scripts/quality/with-target-version.ts'
              - 'scripts/release/target-compatibility.json'
              - 'formats/tokens/**'
              - 'formats/components/**'
              - 'packages/utils/**'

  foundation_compatibility:
    needs: [build, foundation_changes]
    if: needs.foundation_changes.outputs.foundation == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Set up Vite+

Use an array when you need more than one dependency field:

## Running in a Workspace

With no package-selection flags, `vp run` runs the task in the package in your current working directory:

```bash
cd packages/app
vp run build
```

You can also target a package explicitly from anywhere:

```bash
vp run @my/app#build
```

Workspace package ordering is based on the normal monorepo dependency graph declared in each package's `package.json`. In other words, when Vite+ talks about package dependencies, it means the regular `dependencies` relationships between workspace packages, not a separate task-runner-specific graph.

### Recursive (`-r`)

Run the task in every workspace package, in dependency order:

```bash
vp run -r build
```

That dependency order comes from the workspace packages referenced through `package.json` dependencies.

### Transitive (`-t`)

Run the task in one package and all of its dependencies:

```bash
vp run -t @my/app#build
```

If `@my/app` depends on `@my/utils`, which depends on `@my/core`, this runs all three in order. Vite+ resolves that chain from the normal workspace package dependencies declared in `package.json`.

### Filter (`--filter`)

Select packages by name, directory, or glob pattern. The syntax matches pnpm's `--filter`:

```bash
# By name
vp run --filter @my/app build

# By glob
vp run --filter "@my/*" build

# By directory
vp run --filter ./packages/app build

# Include dependencies
vp run --filter "@my/app..." build

# Include dependents
vp run --filter "...@my/core" build

lint --> test --> build
```

Flags also work inside nested scripts. For example, `vp run -r build` inside a script expands into individual build tasks for every package.

::: info
A common monorepo pattern is a root script that runs a task recursively:

```json [package.json (root) ~vscode-icons:file-type-node~]
{
  "scripts": {
    "build": "vp run -r build"
  }
}
```

This creates a potential recursion: root's `build` -> `vp run -r build` -> includes root's `build` -> ...

Vite Task detects this and prunes the self-reference automatically, so other packages build normally.
:::

## Concurrency

By default, up to 4 tasks run at the same time. Use `--concurrency-limit` to change this:

```bash
# Run up to 8 tasks at once
vp run -r --concurrency-limit 8 build

# Run tasks one at a time
vp run -r --concurrency-limit 1 build
```

The limit can also be set via the `VP_RUN_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT` environment variable. The `--concurrency-limit` flag takes priority over the environment variable.

### Parallel Mode

Use `--parallel` to ignore task dependencies and run all tasks at once with unlimited concurrency:

```bash
vp run -r --parallel dev
```

This is useful when tasks are independent and you want maximum throughput. You can combine `--parallel` with `--concurrency-limit` to run tasks without dependency ordering but still cap the number of concurrent tasks:

```bash
vp run -r --parallel --concurrency-limit 4 dev
```

name: CI

# The PR gate: build, typecheck, test, lint, and the publish/provenance checks — everything `ready`
# plus the gates covers, split into parallel jobs. Runs on every PR and on pushes to main so a
# regression is caught before merge, not at docs-deploy or release-tag time.

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  # `workflow_dispatch` lets CodSpeed trigger a backtest run to seed baseline data for the
  # `benchmarks` job; jobs gated on `pull_request` simply no-op on a manual run.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Supersede in-flight PR runs; let main runs finish.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# Every job carries `timeout-minutes`. release.yml's gate waits on this workflow's conclusion with a
# 1-hour deadline, so a job left on the 6-hour default can hang the release even when it's advisory.
# Values are ~2.5x observed runtime — these catch hangs, not slow-but-working jobs.

env:
  # vp's task cache stores task OUTPUTS as .tar.zst tarballs, so a cache hit re-materializes the
  # gitignored generated dirs. The `build` job warms it; downstream jobs restore and replay
  # `vp run -r build` as a fast cache-extract instead of a cold rebuild.
  #
  # Key shape: `<prefix><os>-<hash(pnpm-lock.yaml, vite.config.ts)>-<run_id>-<run_attempt>`.
  #
  # The hash segment has to be in the SAVE key, not just the restore-keys — a restore-key only ever
  # matches a key some run actually wrote. Omitting it made `<prefix><os>-<hash>-` dead config that
  # could never match, silently degrading every restore to the broad `<prefix><os>-` fallback (i.e.
  # "the newest cache from any lockfile").
  #
  # The run_id/run_attempt tail keeps each attempt's key unique, because GH Actions cache keys are
  # immutable: a sha-based key can never be resaved by a rerun, so a `build` job whose auto-tracked
  # output snapshot was incomplete for that attempt would pin every downstream job (and every rerun of
  # the same commit) to that broken tarball forever. A fresh key per attempt means a rerun always
  # saves, and downstream jobs in this attempt exact-match this attempt's own build.
  VP_TASK_CACHE: node_modules/.vite/task-cache
  VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX: vp-taskcache-

jobs:
  automation-guard:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/guard-release-automation.yml
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore/save vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Build all packages
        run: vp run -r build
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  component-accessibility:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 55
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Provision audit browser
        run: vp exec -F @pantoken/components automatica11y doctor --install-browser
      - name: Audit authored component examples
        run: vp run audit:components
      - name: Summarize advisory results
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          found=false
          for summary in a11y-report/*/index.md; do
            if [ -f "$summary" ]; then
              cat "$summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              found=true
            fi
          done
          if [ "$found" = false ]; then
            echo "No accessibility report was generated. Check the setup and build logs; this is not a clean audit." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload advisory accessibility evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7
        with:
          name: component-accessibility
          path: a11y-report/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  typecheck:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

# @pantoken/validate-generated

Validate pantoken's generated output. Run it after the workspace is built, so every package's
`generate` and `embed` step has already written its `generated/` dir. It's the pantoken analog of a
drift gate: it fails the build if any generator produced nothing, if the `pantoken` CLI can't emit a
supported target, or if a generated stylesheet references an `--instui-*` token the IR doesn't define.

Internal build tooling. Not published.

## Usage

```sh
# after `vp run -r build`:
pnpm --filter @pantoken/validate-generated validate
# or directly:
node tools/validate-generated/index.ts
```

It prints a `✓`/`✗` line per check and exits non-zero if anything fails.

## What it checks

- **Generator output** — every generator package (formats, platforms, and renderers, plus
  `@pantoken/ai`) wrote a non-empty `generated/` dir.
- **CLI targets** — `pantoken generate <target>` emits at least one file for every supported target
  (swift, android, compose, flutter, wordpress, vanilla, drupal, swatches, rust, icon-font, pendo,
  jekyll, and hugo), run into a temp dir.
- **Reference integrity** — no generated stylesheet drifts from the token IR. Self-contained sheets
  (`formats/css`, `renderers/pendo`) must have no dangling `var()` references
  (`danglingReferences`); bridge sheets (`renderers/bootstrap`, `shadcn`, `docusaurus`, `vitepress`,
  `plugins/pantoken/custom-components`) must reference only real tokens (`unknownReferences`), aside
  from the shared `--instui-elevation-*`/`--instui-focus-outline-*` sheets they intentionally lean on.

    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Vite+
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          cache: true
          run-install: true
      - name: Restore vp task cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
        with:
          path: ${{ env.VP_TASK_CACHE }}
          key: ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'vite.config.ts') }}-
            ${{ env.VP_CACHE_KEY_PREFIX }}${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Materialize generated output
        run: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 1 build
      - name: Re-audit components whose inputs changed
        run: vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:accessibility
      - name: Require committed evidence to match
        run: git diff --exit-code -- docs/public/accessibility/results.json
      - name: Summarize advisory results
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          found=false
          for summary in a11y-report/*/index.md; do
            if [ -f "$summary" ]; then
              cat "$summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              found=true
            fi
          done
          if [ "$found" = false ]; then
            echo "Accessibility evidence is current; no component needed re-auditing." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload advisory accessibility evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7
        with:
          name: component-accessibility
          path: a11y-report/
